Summary:
- The page outlines a step-by-step guide for accountants on preparing for KSeF (Polish National System of e-Invoicing) in 2026.
- Key dates: KSeF becomes mandatory for large taxpayers from Feb 1, 2026; for the majority of firms from Apr 1, 2026.
- Core changes: Invoices will be issued and received in XML format through KSeF; accountants may gain automatic access to clients’ invoices.
- Steps for accountants:
  1) Understand changes and deadlines (new mandatory usage by 2026, XML format).
  2) Review current document workflows and identify required changes; coordinate with clients on new contracts and collaboration model.
  3) Choose compatible software or update systems to integrate with KSeF; consider MF free apps (Aplikacja Podatnika KSeF, e-mikrofirma).
